title: How to Cancel Paramount+ — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Paramount+ subscription in 2 minutes. Works for Essential and With Showtime plans. Stop paying and keep access until renewal.
intro: Paramount+ cancellation is done through their website and takes about 2 minutes. You keep access through the end of your billing period.

steps.title: Go to your Paramount+ account
steps.text: Visit paramountplus.com and sign in. Click your profile icon in the top-right and select "Account".

steps.title: Find subscription settings
steps.text: On the Account page, locate "My Subscription" section showing your current plan and renewal date.
steps.tip: If subscribed through Apple, Amazon, or Roku, you'll see a note directing you to cancel through that platform.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Subscription"
steps.text: Click "Cancel Subscription". Paramount+ will show what you'll lose and your access end date.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click through any retention offers and confirm. You'll receive an email confirmation and keep access until your billing period ends.
steps.tip: Paramount+ often runs $1.99/mo deals for returning subscribers, so you may get a great offer if you want to come back later.

warnings: If you subscribed via Apple, Amazon, or Roku, cancel through their subscription settings.
If you have the Paramount+ with Showtime bundle, canceling removes both services.
Downloaded content becomes unavailable after your subscription ends.
Promotional pricing won't be available if you re-subscribe at full price.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Paramount+?
faqs.a: Paramount+ does not typically offer refunds for partial periods. Contact their help center for billing errors. If billed through Apple/Google, request refund through them.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Paramount+ plans?
faqs.a: Essential ($5.99/mo) has ads and limited content. With Showtime ($11.99/mo) is ad-free, includes Showtime content, offline downloads, and local CBS live.
Yes. Your profile, watchlist, and viewing history are preserved. If you re-subscribe, everything will be as you left it.

faqs.q: Does Paramount+ offer a free trial?
faqs.a: Paramount+ occasionally offers 7-day free trials for new subscribers. Check their homepage or look for promotional offers through partner services.

refund.details: Paramount+ does not offer prorated refunds. Access continues until the end of your current billing period.

retentionTactics: Paramount+ may offer a discounted rate (often $1.99-2.99/mo for a few months).
They'll highlight exclusive content and upcoming releases.
